text:
tara: Quick follow-up from RFC: we prototyped a mid-stream precision swap for streaming responses (4-bit -> int8) to recover tail collapse. Sharing notes here and checking ops/compat concerns.

ben: Nice. How do you detect mid-stream? We need a cheap heuristic so runtime can flip without heavy compute.

tara: We used a simple tail_loss_ratio metric computed over a sliding window of the last N tokens (N=64). If tail_loss_ratio > 0.25 for >= 2 consecutive windows -> signal mid_swap.

oliver: Important: switching mid-stream touches KV cache format. Our prototype invalidates partial cache and rehydrates from scratch which adds ~120ms for long-context models. That's too slow for many endpoints.

nina: Can we instead keep a parallel small-format cache for the fallback profile and merge on the fly? That sounds complex but might shave latency.

ben: Tradeoffs: parallel cache doubles memory. Maybe do it only for high-traffic endpoints marked as "mid-swap-enabled". Add metadata: mid_swap_cost: "mem_high|latency_impact".

tara: Agreed. We'll add a profile flag mid_swap_enabled and mid_swap_cost estimate. Runtime prefers fallbacks that are cache-compatible; otherwise it uses graceful degrade (finish current stream then switch for subsequent requests).

oliver: Ops: need a safe default: mid-swap disabled. Enable only behind canary and customer opt-in. Also emit an event every time we trigger a mid-swap for auditing.

nina: Also surfaced: billing implications when mid-swap triggers (double-generations during overlap). Add cost_estimate_delta to profile metadata so SRE/accounting can simulate.

ben: For detection false positives: add a short cooldown per-stream (<=1 swap per request) and a global rate limit (swaps/min per model).

tara: Pseudocode for runtime heuristic we used in POC:
```
if (profile.mid_swap_enabled && tail_loss_ratio > profile.tail_threshold && cooldown_ok && rate_limit_ok) {
  try_mid_swap(); // attempt fast-compatible profile or parallel cache
} else if (tail_loss_ratio > emergency_threshold) {
  mark_request_for_post_switch(); // finish then switch next request
}
```

oliver: Monitoring: track swaps_per_minute, avg_swap_latency, pct_streams_recovered, and mem_delta_peak. We'll add dashboards and alerts: swap_rate spike > 3x baseline -> Pager.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created staging job `midstream-swap-canary` sampling 0.5% of traffic, runs every 1m, logs to staging/midswap.

tara: Next steps: I'll update the RFC appendix with profile fields: mid_swap_enabled, mid_swap_cost, tail_threshold, cooldown_s, cost_estimate_delta. Owners: tara (runtime), ben (metrics), oliver (sre). Nina will coordinate billing estimation.

ben: Minor: document user-visible semantics for partial-mid-swap (we may append a header in stream indicating a precision change). Transparency is good.

tara: Good call. We'll emit a small JSON control message in the stream: {"precision_change":"int8","timestamp":...} when swap happens.

nina: Sounds reasonable. I'll run cost delta sims and post results in this thread.

tara: Thanks all — will ping when appendix is ready for review. :tada:
